summary: CVR Energy filed an 8-K reporting entry into an underwriting agreement on November 3, 2026 with Barclays and Jefferies as representatives, covering a marketed follow-on offering of 10,515,248 common shares at $47.55 per share, plus a 30-day option for 1,577,287 additional shares. The offering closed November 5, 2026, yielding roughly $490.0 million in net proceeds before expenses. Proceeds fund the previously disclosed acquisition of the St. Paul Park and Mandan refineries and related marketing and logistics assets from Marathon Petroleum affiliates, plus redemption of the 5.750% 2028 notes. This is an ordinary shelf takedown, not a special situation.
